shots.subject: Darkness; the foundry stroke
shots.camText: Black · sound only
shots.note: The film's pulse arrives before any picture, so the audience leans into the dark.

shots.subject: The copper coupling on its chains; the worker under it
shots.camText: Extreme wide · 32 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: Nothing has a size until a person stands under it: the film's first lesson in scale.

shots.subject: Soot-black hands, pale gloved hands, the silver ring, the violet seam
shots.camText: Insert · 50 mm · ring height 4.8 m (gantry) · locked-off
shots.note: The ward's only warning, hidden in plain sight; it means nothing until 10.4.

shots.subject: Rows of identical couplings waiting in the dark
shots.camText: Wide · 40 mm · eye level 1.6 m · slow push-in
shots.note: Not one machine but a ledger of them: dread by repetition.

scenes.slug: EXT. SOLFORIZ - THE FALLEN GATE - PRE-DAWN

shots.subject: The glass plain, the causeway, the broken gate, the capital and the Crown
shots.camText: Extreme wide · 32 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: The city looks permanent, and the sky is left empty for something that has not come yet.

shots.subject: Wounded men walking back along the causeway; abandoned cannon
shots.camText: Wide · 35 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: The cost walks out of the city before we go in.

shots.subject: The white truce lamp over the gatehouse; civilians on the great stair
shots.camText: Long-lens wide · 85 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: One white light keeps a whole city's people moving: a promise you can see.

shots.subject: The Solforiz battery in the high arcades
shots.camText: Long-lens · 100 mm · eye level 1.6 m, up 6° · locked-off
shots.note: The truce is breaking, and the king is not the one who breaks it.

scenes.slug: EXT. GATE FORECOURT - FOOT OF THE GREAT STAIR - CONTINUOUS

shots.subject: The arch signal station and its lit lantern; Liora bringing civilians down; the boy on her coat
shots.camText: Wide · 32 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: Meet her working: the signal keeper bringing people down under the one lit lantern.

shots.subject: The shell hitting the terrace above Liora; the block tearing loose
shots.camText: Long-lens wide · 75 mm · eye level 1.6 m, up 8° · locked-off
shots.note: Fast and almost too small to see, so that the stop which follows is huge.

shots.subject: Liora and the boy under the stopped block; Cael ten paces off
shots.camText: Wide · 35 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off · long hold
shots.note: The impossible, without spectacle: we wait under the stone with her and find the cause in the frame ourselves.

shots.subject: Cael's open hand; the block and Liora beyond it
shots.camText: Hand template · 40 mm · hand height 1.95 m · locked-off
shots.note: Open: it saves. The first time we see the hand, it does good.

shots.subject: Cael's grip on Liora's wrist; his face beyond

lines.speaker: CAEL
lines.text: Look at me. Find your feet.

shots.camText: Close · 50 mm · Liora's eye 0.7 m · locked-off · shallow
shots.note: Near: the camera is where she is, close enough to feel the grip.

shots.subject: The empty place under the block; the block landing
shots.camText: Wide · 35 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: Aftermath over impact: we watch the empty place she was, not the stone hitting her.

shots.subject: Two fingers testing the boy's respirator seal
shots.camText: Insert · 50 mm · boy's eye 1.0 m · locked-off
shots.note: The hand that held the stone checks a child's seal: care at the smallest scale.

shots.subject: The standard-bearer turning back
shots.camText: Wide · 40 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: Someone saw it; the bound banner is the first sign of what it will cost.

shots.size: Wide (frame inside the frame: the arch)
shots.subject: The boy set under the arch in sight of the truce lamp; Liora going back up

lines.speaker: LIORA
lines.text: May the child survive in the ash.
lines.subtitle: May the child survive in the ash.

shots.camText: Wide · 35 mm · boy's eye 1.0 m · locked-off
shots.note: She leaves the child in sight of the only promise left and goes back for the others.

shots.subject: The command post; the breach holding the arch and the boy

lines.speaker: SOLDIER
lines.text: Third assault, Cyning. The inner batteries still hold.

shots.camText: Wide · 32 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: The argument to come is about the boy in the breach, and he is in the first frame.

shots.subject: The envoy, stopped
shots.camText: Medium · 50 mm · eye level 1.7 m · locked-off
shots.note: The reaction is held longer than the lines: the envoy learns his place in one silence.

shots.subject: The wounded soldier and Cael; the envoy left out of frame

lines.speaker: SOLDIER
lines.text: Half the company reached the wall.

lines.speaker: CAEL
lines.text: Clear the road. Bring them in.

shots.camText: Medium two-shot · 40 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: Two soldiers, level, the diplomat shut out: the king listens to the cost first.

shots.subject: Two stretchers carried in; the blind navigator; the door guard; Cael's nod
shots.camText: Wide · 27 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: An enemy is carried in under the king's nod: the road is cleared for both sides.

shots.size: Insert, low across the table (the judgments)
shots.subject: Three judgments under three different seals, under the campaign map

lines.speaker: ENVOY
lines.text: The Ash-Caliph asks for another council.

shots.camText: Insert · 50 mm · table level 1.05 m · locked-off
shots.note: Paper is the only old thing on the table: three promises, broken and kept.

shots.subject: Cael's finger on one seal

lines.speaker: CAEL
lines.text: He wagered his crown and lost it. That is his seal.

shots.camText: Insert · 50 mm · 25° onto the table · locked-off · shallow
shots.note: He does not argue; he puts a finger on the evidence.

shots.subject: Cael and the envoy flanking the breach; the boy small under the arch between them

lines.speaker: ENVOY
lines.text: The Ash-Caliph will not live beneath your law.

lines.speaker: CAEL
lines.text: The same law as that boy.

lines.speaker: ENVOY
lines.text: You do not own his people.

shots.camText: Wide · 35 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: The whole argument is staged around a child neither man can reach.

shots.size: Hand close shot (the closed hand forced open)
shots.angle: Cael's own eye, looking down at his hand
shots.subject: Cael's hand on the campaign map: closes, then is made to open
shots.camText: Hand template · 40 mm · Cael's eye, looking down · locked-off
shots.note: He forces a closed hand open; holding back costs him.

shots.subject: Cael and the envoy side by side, both facing the breach

lines.speaker: ENVOY
lines.text: Come to the council. You would be safe.

shots.camText: Medium-wide · 40 mm · eye level 1.7 m · slow push-in
shots.note: Two men looking at the same city and wanting opposite things from it.

shots.subject: Dust falling on the judgments; the envoy shutting his eyes
shots.camText: Medium-wide · 35 mm · table level 1.05 m · locked-off
shots.note: Before the fall, dust only falls: the envoy knows the shot was his own side's.

shots.subject: Cael sends the envoy back

lines.speaker: CAEL
lines.text: Look what he built with them.

shots.camText: Medium-wide · 35 mm · eye level 1.7 m · locked-off
shots.note: Symmetry when Cael commands: the decision has a centre.

shots.subject: The envoy, small on the great stair, reaching the inner wall; its gate shutting
shots.camText: Long-lens wide · 85 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: The last door closes; talking is over.

shots.subject: The blind navigator turning his face up to where the truce lamp hangs
shots.camText: Medium · 50 mm · his eye 0.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: The blind man sees it first. (The six-minute cut loses this shot.)

shots.subject: The truce lamp over the gatehouse, shot out
shots.camText: Wide · 50 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: White leaves the film: the truce dies as one small light going out.

shots.size: Medium two-shot in profile (between the road and the boy)
shots.subject: The captain showing the open causeway; Cael looking at the boy under the arch

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: We can withdraw with the wounded.

lines.speaker: CAEL
lines.text: And leave him to finish this?

shots.camText: Medium two-shot · 35 mm · eye level 1.7 m · locked-off
shots.note: The choice is laid out in space: the open road on one side, the child on the other.

shots.subject: Every gun on the terraces opening up; a strike into Aethelgard's lines
shots.camText: Wide · 35 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: Aftermath over impact: we see the gaps, not the bodies.

shots.size: Wide, two figures from behind (the vertical city)
shots.subject: Cael looking up to the Crown; the captain following his eyes; lamps moving down the stair

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: Those works feed the batteries and the lower city. The stairs are still full.

shots.camText: Wide · 40 mm · eye level 1.7 m · locked-off
shots.note: The picture says it before the line does: the stairs are full while he says so.

shots.subject: Cael: 'I know.'
shots.camText: Close-up · 50 mm · eye level 1.75 m · locked-off
shots.note: Clear: his face at 'I know.' is fully readable. Nothing hides what he does.

shots.size: Extreme wide interior (the order, held wide)
shots.subject: 'Bring it down.' The captain turning to the guns
shots.camText: Extreme wide · 24 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off · long hold
shots.note: The worst decision in the film is held at a distance, so the audience has to sit with it.

shots.subject: Aethelgard's batteries fire; the standard-bearer's hand stopped at the bindings
shots.camText: Wide · 35 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: Aethelgard fires; the colour is held back, bound.

scenes.slug: EXT. THE CROWN / THE BREACH / THE STAIR - CONTINUOUS

shots.size: Long-lens wide (the Crown takes the salvo)
shots.subject: The works taking the salvo; armoured shutters closing plate by plate
shots.camText: Long-lens wide · 100 mm · eye level 1.6 m, up 9° · locked-off
shots.note: The city is not a target but a body closing its eyes.

shots.subject: The last shutter stopping; the air warping at its edge
shots.camText: Long-lens · 135 mm · eye level 1.6 m, up 9° · locked-off
shots.note: Something is holding the city's eye open; we feel who before we see him.

shots.subject: Cael's raised open hand in the breach; the stalled shutter beyond
shots.camText: Hand template · 40 mm · hand height 2.0 m · locked-off · long hold
shots.note: Open: it destroys. The same frame as 3.4, now doing the opposite.

shots.subject: The navigator sitting bolt upright, face to the Crown, striking the rail: ONE. TWO.
shots.camText: Medium · 50 mm · his eye 0.95 m · locked-off
shots.note: The blind man counts what he sees: a Seen report, four beats ahead.

shots.subject: LIORA'S POV from the lower flight: the king at the breach, the open hand, then the stalled shutter
shots.camText: Long-lens POV · 135 mm · Liora's eye 1.5 m · one tilt up
shots.note: She is the only one who has seen the hand do both things.

shots.subject: The navigator's hand striking the rail
shots.camText: Insert · 50 mm · rail level 0.8 m · locked-off
shots.note: The count completes; now the cuts speed up.

shots.subject: The second salvo going in
shots.camText: Wide · 35 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: Fast: the decision is already made.

shots.subject: Only then does the hand come down
shots.camText: Wide · 32 mm · eye level 1.7 m · locked-off
shots.note: The cover image, used once: the moment the hand lets go.

shots.subject: The shutter dropping shut; fire coming through; a tower falling across the great retaining wall; the wall giving
shots.camText: Long-lens wide · 75 mm · eye level 1.6 m, up 7° · locked-off
shots.note: The cause is seen, so the fall that follows is his.

shots.subject: The pulse stumbling; the city's lamps going out together
shots.camText: Extreme wide · 32 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: Furnace amber leaves the film: the city's heart stops.

shots.subject: Liora driving the last civilians down; dust taking the flight behind her
shots.camText: Medium-wide · 32 mm · eye level 1.5 m · handheld
shots.note: Panic is the only thing the camera is allowed to shake for.

shots.subject: Liora reaching the arch; the boy and a dozen others; the smashed lantern; the mirror
shots.camText: Medium · 35 mm · eye level 1.4 m · handheld
shots.note: She saves the one thing that can still hold light.

shots.subject: A terrace settling; houses leaning together into dust; the stair going; the upper city coming down
shots.camText: Extreme wide · 32 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: Held wide, the fall is a fact, not a spectacle; the small arch tells us who is under it.

shots.size: Wide (frame inside the frame: the skyline gone)
shots.subject: When the dust thins, the skyline is gone
shots.camText: Wide · 27 mm · eye level 1.5 m · locked-off
shots.note: Aftermath: the absence is the image.

shots.subject: Silence on both sides; the first direct sun; steam from broken pipes
shots.camText: Extreme wide · 32 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: The sky is emptied out a second time, and waits.

shots.size: Wide, side-on along the army line
shots.subject: The men who do not agree on what they have seen; 'We've won.'
shots.camText: Wide · 40 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: One boy says the word everyone else refuses.

shots.subject: Nobody answers; the standard-bearer lowering the pole
shots.camText: Medium · 50 mm · eye level 1.7 m · locked-off
shots.note: The king's silence is the answer.

shots.subject: The army as a band of small silhouettes; only the pipes
shots.camText: Extreme wide · 40 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off · long hold
shots.note: Victory with nothing in it.

shots.subject: Under the arch, grit falling; Liora looking up; the pulse
shots.camText: Medium · 50 mm · her eye 1.0 m · locked-off
shots.note: The arch is failing, and something else is coming.

shots.size: Wide, the captain in the foreground third
shots.subject: The captain looking at the sky; a shadow sliding across the army
shots.camText: Wide · 32 mm · eye level 1.7 m · locked-off
shots.note: Shadow before shape: the threat arrives as a change in the light.

shots.size: Extreme wide (the anchor: the first ship)
shots.subject: Out of the sunrise: lights and a dark mass in the dust; the broken gate towers
shots.camText: Extreme wide · 35 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: The towers that looked huge in scene 2 are now the small thing that measures.

shots.subject: A keel coming clear; then the whole vessel
shots.camText: Wide · 27 mm · eye level 1.6 m, up 12° · slow pan
shots.note: Not a weapon but years of work, arriving.

shots.angle: level with the ring (airborne, inside the hull)
shots.subject: The copper coupling from the foundry, turning under load; scarred; the same silver ring
shots.camText: Insert · 50 mm · ring height (inside the hull) · locked-off
shots.note: What we watched being made carries the fleet: years in one cut.

shots.subject: The arch beginning to give; bars of sunrise through the rigging
shots.camText: Wide · 32 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: The people who survived the fall are about to be crushed by what is left of it.

shots.subject: Liora putting the mirror in a bar of sun; four flashes on the ship's belly
shots.camText: Medium-wide · 35 mm · Liora's eye 1.5 m, up 15° · locked-off
shots.note: White returns, in her hand: the count her city lived by.

shots.angle: high: the ward officer's side of the glass, looking down 35°
shots.subject: The ward officer at the round observation glass: the flashes cross her mask; she opens a hand
shots.camText: Hand template · 40 mm · her side of the glass, high · locked-off
shots.note: Open: another protects. The same frame as 3.4 and 6.3, and it is not his hand.

shots.size: Wide, at the boy's eye (the ward)
shots.angle: the boy's eye level, tilted up 12°
shots.subject: A bell note; violet light dropping from the keel; the falling arch stopping above their heads; the boy looking up
shots.camText: Wide · 24 mm · boy's eye 1.0 m, up 12° · locked-off
shots.note: Rescue from a stranger: the same miracle as the held stone, with someone else's hand.

shots.subject: Behind the first ship, two more; then a formation; and more
shots.camText: Wide · 32 mm · eye level 1.7 m · locked-off
shots.note: The sky held open in scene 2 begins to fill.

shots.subject: The boy pointing at Cael; Liora lowering his hand; her hand settling over her wrist
shots.camText: Close · 50 mm · Liora's eye 1.5 m · locked-off · shallow · long hold
shots.note: Far: she sees him small, and her own hand covers the place he held.

shots.subject: Cael sees her; then the boy; then the people under another power's protection
shots.camText: Long-lens POV · 135 mm · Cael's eye 1.75 m · locked-off
shots.note: His look matches hers at 6.5: the long lens is how these two see each other.

shots.size: Close shot, shallow (his hand, mirroring her wrist)
shots.subject: It goes through him; the hand at his side will not stop shaking; he looks behind him for the road
shots.camText: Close · 50 mm · hand height 0.95 m · locked-off · shallow
shots.note: Far: his hand stays clear and shakes in front of her, so we see that he knows her.

shots.size: Medium two-shot in profile, symmetrical (the road between them)
shots.subject: The road he was offered, with the fleet's shadow along it; the captain level with Cael for the first time

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: You do not get to stop now.

shots.camText: Medium two-shot · 40 mm · eye level 1.75 m · locked-off · long hold
shots.note: The road out is right there between them, and the captain will not let him take it.

shots.subject: Cael making the hand close, the army beyond it
shots.camText: Hand template · 40 mm · hand height 1.3 m · locked-off
shots.note: Closed: war. The last of the four hands, and the only one that does not hold anything up.

shots.subject: Cael raising his eyes to the fleet; 'Raise the banners.'; the captain's signal
shots.camText: Medium · 50 mm · eye level 1.75 m · locked-off
shots.note: Symmetry when Cael commands: the line lands on the look, as the bible stages it.

shots.size: Medium-wide, alone in frame (the first banner)
shots.subject: The standard-bearer seeing the signal; tearing the bindings off; his banner opening alone
shots.camText: Medium-wide · 40 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: He wanted to be told it was worth it; now he is told to fight.

shots.subject: This time he is answered: banner after banner, ragged; not every man, not the captain; Cael does not turn
shots.camText: Long-lens wide · 85 mm · eye level 1.7 m · locked-off
shots.note: An army choosing, not cheering.

shots.subject: Weapon housings opening along the nearest hull
shots.camText: Wide · 50 mm · eye level 1.6 m, up 25° · locked-off
shots.note: The fire comes back, on the other side.

shots.subject: The army under its banners; the ruined capital between; the coalition filling the sky
shots.camText: Extreme wide · 32 mm · eye level 1.6 m · locked-off
shots.note: The sky he was given in scene 2 is full.

shots.subject: The lock; the title; one engine stroke
shots.camText: Black · sound only
shots.note: The pulse, which began in the foundry, belongs to the fleet now.
